title: Lloyd's Mod
description: A mod that adds a biome and new items
body:
This is my first ever mod. Lloyd's Mod introduces an emerald pickaxe, a new biome, a god sword, a god pickaxe and more so please check it out and tell me how good it is for my very first mod.
The God sword has faster cooldown and deals way more damage than the netherite sword. It can be crafted with a stick and 2 smelted netherite. As the name says, smelted netherite can be obtained by smelting netherite in a normal furnace. There can also be crafter a god pickaxe.
This is a bit more complicated. In a smithing table you must put 1 netherite ingot, 1 netherite pickaxe and 1 God sword. By doing this you will obtain the god pickaxe wich has faster mining speed, even being able to insta-mine stone with the efficency 5 enchant. There is also a new biome called The Energized Forest wich has a diffrent fog and has slime instead of dirt. You can find normal plains villages, as the biome was a plains biome energized.

I hope you like the mod, byee
